title: Team
description: A grid of the people behind the product, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Avatar, Button and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading, a sentence of introduction, then each member's Avatar, name, role and a short bio, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the avatar moves beside the name at @sm, the members sit in two columns and the heading steps up at @md, and three columns with more room at @lg.
